review.finding: Autonomy detection only accepts --autonomous among LEADING flags; a trailing flag or a quoted flag value is missed, so the run is treated as interactive.
review.suggestion: Parse flags with their arity and also accept a trailing --autonomous.

review.finding: Skill-path detection uses a plain substring match, disagreeing with the slash-command path.
review.suggestion: Use the same flag parser for both.

review.finding: Scan state is persisted only on the block path; passed-through Stops rescan from offset 0 and read the whole file with fh.read().
review.suggestion: Persist the scan whenever the pointer is live; iterate lines.

review.finding: Rewrite detection only catches a shrunk file; a rewritten file that grew, or another transcript, is resumed mid-file.
review.suggestion: Store the transcript path and rescan when it differs.

review.finding: A recorded hard blocker cannot be cleared, so a resumed run continues without a guard.
F6 hint is satisfied by any commit on the branch (setup makes a triage sweep commit) and hard-codes origin/main.
review.suggestion: Detect the F6 commit by run_id in the message; resolve the base from origin/HEAD.

review.finding: Pointer liveness check is a raw substring match on serialized JSON and can raise OSError on a pointer retired mid-glob.
The block reason omits --run-id and the allowed codes for record_hard_blocker.py.
The 40-per-run cap and the futile cap release silently.
review.suggestion: Print a stderr diagnostic when a cap releases a Stop.

review.finding: Test gaps: hint branches F6/push/delivery, trailing flag, Skill prose args, half-written last line, scan saved on pass-through.
